violation_type.title: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Use and Clean According to Manufacturer's Instructions (26 TAC §746.2411(1))
violation_type.short_title: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Use and Clean According to Manufacturer's Instructions
violation_type.typical_finding: Several play yards used for infants were observed to be dirty along the top rails of the device.

finding_variants.text: Several play yards used for infants were observed to be dirty along the top rails of the device.
The play yard in the infant classroom did not have a mat that snuggly fit the sides that is currently being used.
A bassinett was used as a playyard for an infant to sleep.   The bassinett  is not sturdy and did not measure 22 inches to lowest part of the mattress. The bassinett was removed at inspection.

An extra mattress pad was observed inside one of the play yard. The warning label states not to use extra padding in the play yard.    Note: Pictures were taken for the file. No infants were in the play yard at the time of the inspection. The padding was removed during my inspection.
Observed an infant in a play yard that had a hole in the mesh lining of the play yard. This was corrected when the infant was moved to another empty play yard.

The play yards were observed with plywood on the bottom for support.   The play yards were not labeled with the infant s name.     Note: The play yards were labeled, and the plywood boards were removed from the play yards.
